test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Nine students A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and Z are seated in one row not necessarily in the same order. D is to the immediate left of C who is at third place to the right of E. B is at one end of the row. H is seated adjacent to both F and G. F is at the third place to the left of B. A is sitting to the immediate left of F. All these nine students are facing the north direction. who is sitting in between D and A?
solution:
Given: Nine students A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and Z.

All these nine students are facing the north direction.

1) B is at one end of the row.

2) F is at the third place to the left of B.

3) A is sitting to the immediate left of F.

4) H is seated adjacent to both F and G.
